resources.title: Krishi Gyaan Kendra
resources.text: Roz ke farming decisions ke liye simple aur practical guidance. Koi topic explore karein, basic information samjhein aur official details ke liye trusted government sources dekhein.
resources.searchPlaceholder: Crop, soil, irrigation, pests search karein…
resources.libraryText: Neeche diye topics se shuru karein. Har guide practical overview aur aage kya seekhna hai, uski direction deti hai.
resources.cropText: Seasonal planning, crop selection, sowing time, field preparation aur basic crop-care routines samjhein.
resources.soilText: Soil testing kyun zaroori hai, Soil Health Card kaise padhein aur balanced nutrients ka use kaise samjhein.
resources.waterText: Irrigation methods, water conservation, drainage aur farm mein paani ka efficient use explore karein.
resources.pestText: Early identification, field monitoring, prevention aur agriculture expert se advice kab leni chahiye, samjhein.
resources.seedsText: Seed quality, safe storage, seed treatment basics aur equipment purchase se pehle apni need assess karein.
resources.insuranceText: Crop insurance basics, weather risks, zaroori records aur notified coverage kahan check karein, samjhein.
resources.noResultsText: Koi doosra word search karein ya selected filters clear karein.
resources.officialText: Current notices, application dates, beneficiary status aur scheme instructions ke liye official portals use karein.

official.pmfbyText: Fasal bima ki jaankari aur services
official.soilText: Soil health services aur related details

resources.disclaimer: Ye guides general educational information hain, local agriculture expert ki advice ka replacement nahi. Scheme rules, dates aur benefits change ho sakte hain; official portal ya implementing department se confirm karein.
resources.guideSafety: Yeh general learning guidance hai. Crop practices, varieties, sowing dates, seed rate, nutrient dose aur plant-protection decisions district, mitti, season aur official recommendations ke hisaab se badalte hain. Field par decision lene se pehle apne Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) ya state agriculture department se confirm karein.
resources.guideSourceNote: Field-level decisions ke liye local KVK aur state agriculture department ki salah lein.

about.title: Agriculture support ko samajhna aur access karna easy banana.
about.text: KrishiAssist scheme discovery, eligibility guidance aur practical next steps ko ek farmer-friendly platform par laata hai.
about.heroTag: Support tak pahunchne ka clearer path
about.whyTitle: Right support dhoondhna complicated nahi hona chahiye.
about.whyText: Government schemes ki information alag-alag portals, notices aur department documents mein ho sakti hai. Eligibility rules samajhna difficult ho sakta hai aur farmers ko documents ya next steps clear nahi hote. KrishiAssist isi information ko navigate karna easier banane ke liye design kiya gaya hai.
about.solutionTitle: Scattered information se clear next steps tak.
about.solutionText: Ek jagah schemes explore karein, apni profile par apply hone wali conditions samjhein, result ka reason dekhein aur application ke liye prepare karein. Platform official process ko explain karta hai, replace nahi.

steps.profileText: Relevant scheme guidance ke liye location, farming activity aur land ki zaroori details add karein.
steps.discoverText: Scheme catalogue browse karein ya batayein ki aapko kis type ki support chahiye.
steps.checkText: Dekhein kaunsi conditions satisfy hoti hain, kahan more information chahiye aur kyun.
steps.prepareText: Apply karne se pehle document checklist, application guidance aur official links review karein.

principles.accessibleText: Simple language aur English, Hindi, Hinglish options information ko follow karna easier banate hain.
principles.transparentText: Eligibility result ke peeche ki conditions dikhayi jaati hain, sirf unexplained label nahi.
principles.privacyText: Sirf wahi information dein jo selected feature ke liye zaroori ho. Passwords ya unnecessary sensitive documents share na karein.
principles.farmerFirstTitle: Kisan ko priority dene wala design
principles.farmerFirstText: Technical jargon ke bajaye practical steps, readable explanations aur useful links par focus hai.

about.importantText: KrishiAssist ek information aur assistance platform hai. Eligibility checks available profile information aur scheme data par based indicative guidance hain. Ye official approval ya benefits ki guarantee nahi hain. Final decision, current rules aur application status relevant government department decide karta hai.

contact.eyebrow: Hum help ke liye yahan hain
contact.title: Hum aapki kaise help kar sakte hain?
contact.text: Scheme questions, official grievances ya KrishiAssist platform feedback ke liye sahi channel choose karein.
contact.helpText: KrishiAssist ek independent information tool hai. Official decisions, application status ya government record correction ke liye scheme ke responsible department se contact karein.
contact.schemeHelpText: Current eligibility, application dates, documents ya payment status ke liye implementing department se contact karein ya official portal use karein.
contact.portalHelpText: Central government service ki grievance ke liye official public grievance portal use karein aur reference number save rakhein.
contact.privacyText: General enquiry mein Aadhaar number, bank details, passwords, OTPs ya complete identity documents share na karein.

contact.formText: Details fill karke message copy karein. Ye demo aapke device par message prepare karta hai; send ya store nahi karta.

rules.RULE_FAILED_GT: Aapki value ({{actual}}) {{expected}} se zyada honi chahiye.
rules.RULE_FAILED_GTE: Aapki value ({{actual}}) kam se kam {{expected}} honi chahiye.
rules.RULE_FAILED_LT: Aapki value ({{actual}}) {{expected}} se kam honi chahiye.
rules.RULE_FAILED_LTE: Aapki value ({{actual}}) zyada se zyada {{expected}} honi chahiye.
rules.RULE_FAILED_IN: Aapki value ({{actual}}) allowed values ({{expected}}) mein shamil nahi hai.
rules.RULE_FAILED_NOT_IN: Aapki value ({{actual}}) us group mein aati hai jise ye scheme exclude karti hai ({{expected}}).
rules.RULE_UNKNOWN: Ab tak di gayi information se ye tay nahi ho sakta.
